facts.fact: Skonk 打开窗，黑影沿窗台滑出；随后 stretched into a thin ribbon and disappeared toward the trees——它奔树林去了。
facts.anchor: curl along the window ledge, and slip outside.

facts.fact: Twobble 吓到擦汗，坚称影子要吃灵魂；Skonk 判定它只是想出去（Actually, I think it just wants outside）。
facts.anchor: “It wants to eat our souls,” Twobble said, dabbing his forehead.

facts.fact: Lady Limora 平静点名：这是 shadow librarian，新书架段开了总得有人照看（Someone had to tend to them）。
facts.anchor: “I think that was a shadow librarian,” she said calmly.

facts.fact: Limora 说是被吓得石化要缓一缓；Skonk 关窗比开窗快得多。
facts.anchor: “It probably got petrified and needs time to regroup.”

facts.fact: Limora 改口称 Maeve 为 Headmistress，说这是她挣来的；Maeve 请她私下仍叫名字。
Maeve 邀 Limora 留校任教被婉拒——她更喜欢学，不喜欢教。
影印离开 Maeve 身体两周、转落到 Celeste 身上，没有明显原因；Maeve 想知道自己愿意扛的担子为何让女儿背。
facts.anchor: The shadow mark had been gone from my body for two weeks and had set itself on Celeste instead.

facts.fact: Shadowick Academy 处于非关非开的 limbo，女祭司不再统治后没人给答案；Gideon 也没接这份责任（Gideon certainly hadn’t claimed that responsibility）。
facts.anchor: now that the Priestess was no longer ruling over the village.

facts.fact: Celeste 的影印发麻约十秒，几天来头一次；Senta 供出起因：We were talking about Shadowick——一谈 Shadowick 就有反应。
Celeste 说不想变成女祭司那样的人；Maeve 安抚 I understand. But I wasn't（我当年没变成那样）。
facts.anchor: “I don’t want to be like her.”

facts.fact: Stella 观察两个村子铁了心要合成一体，连她也觉得意外。
facts.anchor: It’s as if these two villages are determined to act as one.

facts.fact: Nova 提着鸟笼穿过街进 Keegan 的旅店；笼中 Rendel 翅膀收拢一动不动（not so much as a feather moving）——Maeve 没被邀请，预感不喜欢他们在干什么。
